post_title: Job search with H1b in med device/diagnostics
concerns_or_questions_summary: Bay-Area H-1B holder with about 4 years of diagnostics-industry experience and a BME master's is struggling to find medical device or diagnostics companies that will support an H-1B transfer. They ask whether others have recently succeeded with H-1B transfers in this space and for biotech communities or chats to join.
